name: context-menu
useFor: Use for shortcuts to actions on an item in a list (an email in the inbox, a contact). Every action must also be reachable another way, such as a row's menu button.
constraints: Actions that exist only in the context menu
A context menu on text people need to select
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the email list items, nav rows and the raised panel
